armsopen.prompt: A person kneeling and sitting back on the heels with the head tilted back slowly raises both arms out wide to the sides and up, open hands with two fingers extended, holds them there trembling, then slowly lowers them.

dance1.prompt: A woman performs a slow graceful traditional Thai classical dance in place: knees softly bent and gently dipping, one arm rising to shoulder height as the other lowers, wrists rotating slowly with the fingers curved back, the head tilting with each movement.

dance2.prompt: A woman performs a slow traditional Thai dance: both arms extended to the sides at shoulder height with wrists turning and fingers bent back, small soft steps to the left and right, knees bending with each step, the body swaying gracefully.

give.prompt: A person standing holds a wide bowl with both hands at chest height, steps forward and offers it out to someone in front with a small bow of the head, holds it out, then steps back and lowers empty hands.

handson.prompt: A person sitting on a chair leans a little forward and places both hands on an object held up in front at chest height, holds them there quite still for a few seconds, then sits back and rests the hands on the knees.

kneel.prompt: A person standing calmly lowers down onto both knees and sits back on the heels with a straight back, hands resting on the thighs, and stays still.

offer.prompt: A person kneeling and sitting back on the heels holds both hands up in front of the face, palms up and side by side as if lifting a wide bowl to forehead height, the head bowed low beneath it, and holds perfectly still for several seconds, then lowers the hands to the lap.

palmover.prompt: A person sitting on a chair leans forward and holds the open right hand out low in front, palm facing down, as if blessing the head of someone kneeling before the chair, holds it still for several seconds, then sits back.

petals.prompt: A person sitting on a chair reaches the right hand down to a bowl beside the knee, scoops up a handful, and tosses it gently forward and upward in an arc, then lowers the arm to rest.

procession.prompt: A woman wearing a long narrow skirt walks slowly forward in a ceremonial procession with short, unhurried, graceful steps, her back straight and her head level, both hands held together in front of her waist with one hand resting on the other and her elbows relaxed at her sides. She keeps walking forward at the same calm pace the whole time.

prostrate.prompt: A person kneeling and sitting on the heels with palms pressed together at the chest bows slowly forward until the forehead and both palms rest on the floor, holds, then rises back upright with the palms together again.

raise.prompt: A person kneeling upright on both knees holds a heavy bowl in both hands at chest height, slowly lifts it to just above the forehead while bowing the head, holds it there quite still, then slowly lowers it back to the chest.

seiza.prompt: A person kneeling and sitting back on the heels with a straight back and both hands resting on the thighs stays calm and still, breathing slowly, the head turning a little to look left and then right.

standup.prompt: A person kneeling on both knees rises smoothly to stand upright, arms relaxed at the sides.

sway.prompt: A person kneeling and sitting back on the heels with eyes closed and hands resting on the thighs sways the upper body slowly round in a circle, the head rolling loosely, shoulders trembling, as if in a deep trance.

trance1.prompt: A person kneeling on both knees folds forward at the waist with the head hanging low, both arms sweeping slowly out and back behind the body with the wrists turning, the whole body trembling gently, swaying as if in a deep trance.

trance2.prompt: A person kneeling upright with the head tilted slightly back slowly raises both arms high and wide apart with open hands, holds them there trembling, the torso swaying gently from side to side, as if in a spiritual trance.

wai.prompt: A person standing presses both palms together in front of the chest in a respectful greeting, bows the head and shoulders slowly forward, holds a moment, then straightens up and lowers the hands.

walkdance.prompt: A woman in a long narrow skirt dances forward in a slow traditional Thai procession dance: small soft steps, knees gently bending, while her arms move gracefully, one hand rising to shoulder height as the other lowers to her hip, wrists turning with fingers curved back, her body swaying softly and her head tilting with each move. She keeps moving forward at the same slow pace the whole time.

walkdance2.prompt: A woman in a long narrow skirt walks slowly forward with small graceful steps while dancing with her arms: both arms out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows soft, wrists bent back and fingers curled, the arms gently rising and falling alternately like slow wings in time with her steps, back straight, head level. She keeps walking forward at the same calm pace the whole time.
